lines.en: I drift along. The brain arrives first.

lines.zh: 四格宽的影子，压过一片草。
lines.en: A four-block shadow passes over the grass.

lines.zh: 我一边飘，一边往下滴水。
lines.en: I drift and drip as I go.
I don't walk. The ground stays silent.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地，朝有活物的地方去。
lines.en: I drift slowly toward anything alive.

lines.zh: 我的血管露在外面，一跳一跳。
lines.en: My veins show. They pulse.
I pass over cracks without a sound.
I chose this ground.

lines.zh: 我靠近的时候，空气就沉。
lines.en: As I near, the air grows heavy.

lines.zh: 我从来不急，我有的是时间。
lines.en: I'm never hurried. I have time.
I hang there, rising and falling.

lines.zh: 我的裂缝一开一合，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My fissures open and close, as if breathing.

lines.zh: 周围很安静，我的东西都醒着。
lines.en: It's quiet. My creatures are awake.
I count the living things here.

lines.zh: 我不用眼睛，我感觉得到。
lines.en: I don't need eyes. I feel.

lines.zh: 我的外壳下面，一直在动。
lines.en: Something moves under my shell.
I'm waiting for them to come closer.
Too still for too long.
I gather my flesh and spread it again.

lines.zh: 七百七十六条命，我记着的。
lines.en: Five hundred and fifty-two. I keep count.

lines.zh: 我在看，我在等，我在想着。
lines.en: I watch. I wait. I think.
My creatures circle around me.
That light discomforts me.
I need no sleep. Nor want it.

lines.zh: 我一部分留在原地，一部分出去了。
lines.en: Part of me stays. Part of me has gone out.

lines.zh: 我把裂缝收紧，等一会儿。
lines.en: I tighten my fissures and wait.
You stand beneath me, looking up.

lines.zh: 脑沟里全是盯着你的眼。
lines.en: The folds of my brain are full of eyes fixed on you.
The thing in you beats.

lines.zh: 你这么小，值得我低头吗？
lines.en: So small. Worth bowing my mass for?
I can feel your fear.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，对我没用。
lines.en: What you hold is useless against me.
No face, but my whole surface faces you.
Do you have a name? I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我的东西就动了。
lines.en: You come near and my creatures stir.
You retreat; I hover in place.

lines.zh: 脑子里的眼，正数着你的心跳。
lines.en: The eyes in my brain are counting your pulse.

lines.zh: 我见过很多像你一样的。
lines.en: I've seen many like you.

lines.zh: 我凹进去一块，又鼓起来。
lines.en: A dent forms. Then it swells back.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我的东西乱了。
lines.en: That disordered my creatures.
Something flows from my fissures.

lines.zh: 我没有疼，只是少了一点。
lines.en: No pain. Only less of me.

lines.zh: 我退开一格，重新围上来。
lines.en: I back a block and close again.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方，很快会长好。
lines.en: Where you struck will mend.
That left blood on your hands.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，还是对着你。
lines.en: I turn slowly. Still facing you.
My creatures grow restless.
Fourteen armor points hold it off.
I've no need of that.
I only want your heartbeat.
You hold it up. I'm not interested.
I turn my mass away. Slowly.
Keep it. It's useful to you.
I don't eat. I only take.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我看不进去。
lines.en: I can't be bothered with that.
I reach out, then withdraw.
Only living things interest me.
Don't wave that under me.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，从我身上滑开了。
lines.en: You strike me and slide off.
I'm soft. I don't scatter.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你手上沾了东西。
lines.en: That left something on your hands.
I rise slowly to clear the way.
Too close, and the tendrils coil around you.

lines.zh: 我的外壳被撞出了一个口。
lines.en: My shell has a new opening.
I draw back half a block and hover.
You touched me and pulled your hand back.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西，开始动了。
lines.en: The things on me have started moving.
Stay right there. Don't move.

lines.zh: 这种事，不在你们面前做。
lines.en: We don't do this before you.
My creatures spread in a ring first.
Two brains rise and fall together.
Water begins to seep from the ground.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只有血管在响。
lines.en: Neither speaks. Only the veins sound.
This part is not to be watched.
At dawn I withdraw into the dark.

lines.zh: 我的孩子会长成别的东西。
lines.en: My children will grow into other things.

lines.zh: 这地底下，本来就是我们的。
lines.en: This underground was always ours.
It disperses. I remain.

lines.zh: 我用一层薄薄的东西裹住它。
lines.en: I wrap it in a thin layer of myself.

lines.zh: 这个我拿了，反正你也不要。
lines.en: I'll take it. You don't want it anyway.

lines.zh: 它在我身上，慢慢变了颜色。
lines.en: On me, it slowly changes colour.

lines.zh: 我把它放回去，你找不到。
lines.en: I put it back where you won't find it.
Not heavy. I can lift it.

lines.zh: 我把它交给跑腿的东西。
lines.en: I hand it to a runner.
I don't like it. Thrown away.

lines.zh: 它在我身上留下一个印。
lines.en: It leaves a mark on me.
This will do as bait.
I hide it underneath.

lines.zh: 你打了我的东西，我记得。
lines.en: You struck my creatures. Noted.
Four blocks wide, and even my pulse echoes.
I collect this ground now.

lines.zh: 你没有退路，往哪都堵着。
lines.en: No way out. Blocked everywhere.
My fissures open wide.

lines.zh: 你身上的热，我能感觉到。
lines.en: I feel the heat in you.
First immobilize you. Then talk.

lines.zh: 我把自己铺开，盖住地面。
lines.en: I spread out and cover the ground.
This time I won't hold back.

lines.zh: 你数过四周还有几个出口？
lines.en: Have you counted the exits?

lines.zh: 我的一部分已经绕到你后面。
lines.en: Part of me is already behind you.
I'm waiting for you to lift a foot.
I chose where you stand.
Put the weapon down. It'll be easier.
I float here and wait for you to tire.

lines.zh: 这里的空气，已经不太够你用了。
lines.en: The air here is running short for you.
I've been above you, unmoving.
That dripping you hear is me.

lines.zh: 这一次，我不打算放过谁。
lines.en: This time I spare no one.

lines.zh: 你逃不出去，我比这地方大。
lines.en: You can't outrun me. I'm larger than this place.
I follow. Very slowly.

lines.zh: 你往哪跑，我的东西就去哪。
lines.en: Wherever you run, my creatures follow.

lines.zh: 我的一部分在前，一部分在后。
lines.en: Part of me ahead. Part behind.

lines.zh: 你把门关上，门也就没用了。
lines.en: Close the door. It does nothing.
No hurry. I circle.
Every step you take, I drift half a block closer.

lines.zh: 我的血管跳得越来越快。
lines.en: My veins beat faster and faster.

lines.zh: 你听见下面的声音了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear what's below?

lines.zh: 这一片的草，都朝我弯了。
lines.en: The grass here bends toward me.
The fact I haven't moved is the worst.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，墙也会让开。
lines.en: Back to the wall. The wall gives way too.

lines.zh: 我的裂缝在数你的呼吸。
lines.en: My fissures count your breaths.
The more you panic, the more you err.
Half a circle more and I close.

lines.zh: 你在找那个出口？我封了。
lines.en: Looking for that exit? I sealed it.
I keep watching. Watching.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛，长在别人身上。
lines.en: My eyes grow on other bodies.
One block closer and I reach.
You standing there is exactly what I want.
I've waited a long while for this.
I press down and cover the ground.
My creatures rush in. A swarm.
That slowed your movements.

lines.zh: 我用自己的一部分撞过去。
lines.en: I strike with part of myself.
That thing has you. Don't struggle.
The tendrils pull back, ready to reach again.
Your heart stumbled once.
Light, but it leaves a mark.
I push you toward the dark.

lines.zh: 你还站着，比我想的能撑。
lines.en: Still standing. Tougher than I thought.
Part of me is cut away.
Blood seeps from my fissures.
I retreat upward. Slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下，是你自己撞上来的。
lines.en: That one, you walked into.

lines.zh: 地面鼓起一块，然后裂开。
lines.en: The ground swells, then splits.
I rise slowly. Four blocks wide.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西，四散开来。
lines.en: The things on me scatter outward.

lines.zh: 这一片空气，一下变重了。
lines.en: The air here grows heavy at once.
I survey the area for the living.

lines.zh: 我的一部分已经绕到远处。
lines.en: Part of me is already circling wide.
Something begins to flow in my veins.
They summoned me. So I came.
The light here stings.

lines.zh: 我把裂缝打开，慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: I open my fissures and breathe slowly.

lines.zh: 地下本来是我的，现在也是。
lines.en: The underground was mine. Still is.
I hover, taller than the trees.

lines.zh: 你先看到的，是我的影子。
lines.en: What you saw first was my shadow.

lines.zh: 我不用眼睛，我全都知道。
lines.en: I need no eyes. I know it all.

lines.zh: 我的东西在四周站好了。
lines.en: My creatures have taken their places.

lines.zh: 这一片，已经被我围住了。
lines.en: I've already closed around this ground.

lines.zh: 我有五段的血，一段一段来。
lines.en: My life comes in stages. One at a time.

lines.zh: 你听到的声音，是我的血在流。
lines.en: That sound is my blood moving.
In the summoning circle, I take shape slowly.
A four-block-wide brain rises.

lines.zh: 火燎上来，我的表面都焦了。
lines.en: Fire sweeps up and my surface chars.

lines.zh: 我砸在地上，散了一部分。
lines.en: I crash down and part of me scatters.
Water closes over me and I sink.

lines.zh: 炸响把我一部分撕开了。
lines.en: The blast tears part of me away.
It goes in and stays.
Light burns my fissures. It hurts.

lines.zh: 太久没有心跳声，我饿了。
lines.en: No heartbeats for too long. I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 雷穿过去，我整个抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning passes through and I shudder.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: Emptiness below. I keep falling.
